title.description: What the mock shows, in a few words.

goal.description: The question the mock is meant to settle.

mode.description: fast: drawn in the product's tokens; real: built from the running app's captured DOM.

fast_reason.description: Required for a fast mock: the person's own words asking for a sketch, or why the product cannot run here. A fast mock without it is refused by the journey bar.

app_url.description: Where the mock is served (its Flowpad web app URL).

folder.description: The mock's web app folder in the mock project (absolute; never the repo) — the review panel's Open folder shows it.

repo.description: The repo the mock is about (absolute). Save to repo copies the mock into <repo>/agentic-assets/webapp/mock-<slug>/.

session.description: The agentic process that builds the mock — where submitted feedback is sent.

status.description: draft: being built; in_review: shown, collecting feedback; submitted: feedback sent; revised: the mock changed after feedback.

journey.description: LEGACY: the screens as a flat list. New mocks write `tree`; `scripts/tree.py from-journey` converts.

test_md.description: Test mode (`mockify test`): the regression scenario this mock defines, repo-relative, e.g. ui/tests/manual_regression/chat/close_chat.md. Present = the mock is a test scenario of the CURRENT UI.

setup.description: Test mode: the state the test starts from (seed data, signed-in hub, a second instance), in a sentence.

device.description: The screen this step is shown on: desktop (default), iphone (390x844) or android (412x915). A phone step is laid out at its device width, inside a device frame. The journey's default screen; a step's own device wins.

persona.description: The journey's default persona (a `personas` id); a step's own persona wins.

personas.description: Who appears in the journey. Needed as soon as two people's screens are in one mock; every step then names its persona.

tree.description: The mock tree: screens, actions and vars. What the page is built from and what Next / Back walk.
